what_it_does: This paper describes the practical challenges and solutions for running generative AI (GenAI) workloads at high-performance computing (HPC) centers. It details how containerized services—pre-packaged software environments including an inference server (vLLM), databases, and APIs—that were originally designed for cloud computing can be adapted to run on traditional HPC infrastructure. The paper provides lessons learned from deploying a Llama language model inference server.
